comment: Deploying a “basic terminology service” may exceed the initial capacity of some settings, while other countries can begin with governed terminology packages and synchronised value sets rather than a live national service.

anchor.note: p.92 l.Lines 154-161 read as the printed page; section 4.2.2 agrees

public.text: Deploying a “basic terminology service” may exceed the initial capacity of some settings, while other countries can begin with governed terminology packages and synchronised value sets rather than a live national service.
public.suggestedRevision: Allow maturity-appropriate implementation through curated code lists, versioned terminology packages, regional services, local mirrors, or a national runtime service, provided governance and migration paths are defined.
